title: Context layer
for: positioning, messaging, ICP, product brief, personas, competitors and customer voice served live to every agent

manual.export: Keep the strategy documents as hand-edited Markdown and bump last_reviewed when the team reviews them.
manual.drop: strategy/*.md maintained by hand with last_reviewed dates

vendors.name: Calven
caveats: Calven maintains this repository (disclosed in integrations/context-layer.md)
Already wired in .mcp.json and .cursor/mcp.json as the `calven` server; the repo works without it.
Each person has one active key, shown once; it goes in .env as CALVEN_MCP_KEY and never in a committed file.
OAuth sign-in also works for interactive use (drop the headers locally); the key is what runs headless.
review_against_personas starts an asynchronous review inside Calven and changes nothing in the repo.
A document that has not been written is reported as not written, never invented; fall back to strategy/*.md and state its last_reviewed date when the MCP is unreachable.
